input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: research/marine-hull milestone 6zzi: score the learned seasonal correction on every k-subset of learning years to separate history length from recency

doc_friction.issue: Without --timeout it gives up after 100 s; pass --timeout 540 from the first call for a long job.

notes: Predictions were committed (047aecb77) before the run. The run took 14 min on 4 cores and its check reproduced 6zzb exactly. 5 of 8 predictions held. Subset-mean LC_k over 168 cells is 121.8/140.8/149.3/152.2/158.0 (AT_90 139). 6zzb's nearest year ranks last at k=1 and k=2. No recency effect (rho +0.40, n=5, permutation p 0.52). Implication: the one-year rules of 6zzc-6zzh rest on the lag-1 year, so they need a rerun over all five years before the paper. Local checks: unittest test_subset_years + test_learn_years OK; build.py ok; research_live_links, check_md_links, check_post_frontmatter, check_post_links, post_similarity, programme_check all ok.
